context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Dashboard Analytics feature fully functional. Backend has 11 analytics endpoints at /api/saas-admin/analytics/*. Frontend AdminDashboard.js renders 10 sections: Overview, User Metrics, Activity Analytics, Project Analytics, Pipeline Analytics, Retention & Funnels, System Health, All Users, All Projects, Activity Feed. All sections have data-testid attributes for testing. Sidebar can be collapsed. Admin access requires is_staff=true. Login route is /signin.
